caption: The drawing depicts a sleeveless, black vest with vertical gold and light-gray stripes. The vest has a high collar and deep "V" neckline, with the collar creating a notch at the front. The front closure features a row of small round buttons extending vertically down the middle. There are two horizontal slit pockets, one on each side near the bottom front, outlined with the same stripe pattern. The armholes and neckline are light tan inside, contrasting with the outer dark color. In the top right corner of the image, there is a small, lightly sketched back view of the same vest, showing simple construction and two adjuster straps at the back waist. The composition places the main, colored view of the vest centrally and the back view sketch in the upper right, all on a cream background.
title: Waistcoat
